responsibility: Declares the selftest-only subclass of diagnostics::context used to exercise the diagnostics subsystem in checking builds. test_context exposes convenience reporting and locus-capture helpers and setters for source-printing options such as colorization, labels, line numbers, rulers, event links, and caret characters, providing a compact harness API for diagnostics selftests.
same_name_distinction: Declares the selftest test_context class and its helper/setter interface for diagnostics tests, but does not provide the constructor, destructor, start_span callback, or reporting/locus implementations. Unlike selftest-context.cc, this header is the interface used by other selftests.
